mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ccds_vehicle_request (station_id, action, item_json, before_json, status, created_by) VALUES (#{stationId}, #{action}, #{itemJson}, #{beforeJson}, #{status}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE ccds_vehicle_request SET status = #{status}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewer_name = #{reviewerName}, reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, gmt_modified = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, station_id, action, item_json, before_json, status, created_by, reviewed_by, reviewer_name, reviewed_at, gmt_create, gmt_modified FROM ccds_vehicle_request WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, station_id, action, item_json, before_json, status, created_by, reviewed_by, reviewer_name, reviewed_at, gmt_create, gmt_modified FROM ccds_vehicle_request WHERE station_id = #{stationId} ORDER BY id DESC
